mapper.insert: insert into wo_assignment (order_id, engineer_id, engineer_name, engineer_dept_id, assigned_by, assigned_by_name, assigned_at, response_minutes, response_deadline, assignment_status, create_time) values (#{orderId}, #{engineerId}, #{engineerName}, #{engineerDeptId}, #{assignedBy}, #{assignedByName}, #{assignedAt}, #{responseMinutes}, #{responseDeadline}, #{assignmentStatus}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: update wo_assignment set assignment_status = 'REASSIGNED', ended_at = #{endedAt}, return_reason = #{reason} where order_id = #{orderId} and assignment_status in ('ACTIVE', 'ACCEPTED')
update wo_assignment set assignment_status = 'ACCEPTED', accepted_at = #{acceptedAt} where order_id = #{orderId} and engineer_id = #{engineerId} and assignment_status = 'ACTIVE'
